units.name: Operations Management Group (OM)
units.evidence: The official page explicitly names the Operations Management (OM) Group and its current head, with supply chains, process improvement, service operations and operations strategy research. Footer explicitly states Warwick Business School is a department of the University of Warwick.

units.name: Supply Chain Research Group (SCRG)
units.evidence: Current dedicated page provides full group name and SCRG acronym, with manufacturing supply-chain resilience, process optimization, productivity, design and sustainability. The parent homepage gives the full Warwick Manufacturing Group name and WMG acronym and identifies it as a university department.

decisions.reason: Official page directly expands OM as Operations Management and establishes actual subject-group type. The university parent is explicitly identified, supporting display consolidation.

sources.note: Full operations group name/acronym, explicit remit and business-school affiliation to University of Warwick.
All nine business subject groups checked; separate Information Systems Management and Analytics not added on that name alone.
University identity and public academic navigation; only essential cookie preferences retained.
Full academic department inventory identifies both Engineering and Warwick Manufacturing Group, and the business school in Social Sciences.
Full Warwick Manufacturing Group (WMG) name and university departmental status.
Complete displayed manufacturing research inventory and explicit Supply Chain Research Group remit.
Full group name/acronym, parent, research scope and projects; joint JLR innovation hub recorded within group remit rather than duplicated as a department.
School of Engineering overview and research navigation.
Six engineering research clusters and application themes checked; physical modelling/control/materials alone not treated as operations research units.

limitations: Review verifies the named operations and manufacturing supply-chain groups; it does not claim an exhaustive inventory of every mathematical optimization project. Parent university's separately assigned imported labels require their own reconciliation.
